# About E-JUST

Egypt-Japan University of Science and Technology (E-JUST) is an Egyptian public research-oriented university established in partnership with the Japanese government through the Japan International Cooperation Agency (JICA).

title: About E-JUST (Egypt-Japan University of Science and Technology)
label: general
text:
## Location & Campus
- **Main Campus:** New Borg El Arab City, Alexandria Governorate, Egypt.
- **Distance:** Approximately 45 km southwest of Alexandria and near Borg El Arab International Airport.
- **Campus Style:** Eco-friendly smart campus designed in collaboration with Japanese architects, featuring modern laboratories, central library, student dormitories, sports facilities, and green spaces.

title: About E-JUST (Egypt-Japan University of Science and Technology)
label: general
text:
## Mission & Vision
- E-JUST combines the Japanese model of research-based education (Kouza / laboratory-centered learning) with Egyptian academic excellence.
- It focuses on science, engineering, computer science, international business, and sustainable technology, serving Egypt, Africa, and the Middle East.
- Instruction is primarily in **English**, with Japanese language and culture courses integrated into the curriculum.

text: # Admissions & Application Process

title: E-JUST Admissions & How to Apply
label: general
text:
## Undergraduate Admissions
- **Eligibility:** Egyptian Thanaweya Amma (Science/Math tracks depending on faculty), STEM schools, IG/IB, American Diploma, and equivalent international certificates.
- **Entrance Assessment:** Applicants typically take E-JUST admission exams (Mathematics, Physics/Chemistry or Computing depending on track, and English proficiency) and an interview.
- **Application Portal:** Online via the official E-JUST admissions portal (`https://www.ejust.edu.eg`).

title: E-JUST Admissions & How to Apply
label: general
text:
## Postgraduate Admissions (M.Sc. & Ph.D.)
- **Requirements:** Accredited Bachelor's degree (for M.Sc.) or Master's degree (for Ph.D.) in a relevant field, strong academic GPA, English proficiency (TOEFL/IELTS or E-JUST English test), research proposal, and two academic recommendation letters.
- **Selection:** Academic evaluation followed by a technical interview with the department committee.

title: E-JUST Admissions & How to Apply
label: general
text:
## Required Documents
1. Official academic transcripts and graduation certificate (or latest school certificate).
2. Copy of National ID or Passport.
3. Personal photo.
4. English proficiency proof (if available).
5. Updated CV and Statement of Purpose (for postgraduate applicants).

text: # Tuition Fees & Scholarships

title: E-JUST Tuition Fees & Scholarships
label: general
text:
## Tuition Structure
- E-JUST is a national non-profit research university. Tuition fees vary by faculty (Engineering, CSIT, International Business) and student nationality (Egyptian vs. International).
- Fees are announced annually on the official E-JUST website prior to each academic year and can typically be paid in installments per semester.
- For exact current-year figures, always check the official E-JUST admissions/finance page at `https://www.ejust.edu.eg`.

title: E-JUST Tuition Fees & Scholarships
label: general
text:
## Scholarships & Financial Aid
1. **Merit & Excellence Scholarships:** Full or partial tuition waivers for top-performing Egyptian Thanaweya Amma, STEM, and international certificate students.
2. **TICAD / JICA African Scholarships:** Full scholarships for postgraduate students from African countries, covering tuition, accommodation, monthly stipend, and airfare.
3. **E-JUST Postgraduate Fellowships:** Research assistantships and tuition waivers for qualified M.Sc. and Ph.D. candidates working in funded research labs.
4. **Partner & Corporate Scholarships:** Sponsored seats supported by Egyptian ministries, banks, and industrial partners.

## Research Focus Areas
- **Artificial Intelligence, Robotics & Smart Systems:** Computer vision, NLP, autonomous robotics, and embedded AI.
- **Renewable Energy & Sustainability:** Solar energy, water desalination, green hydrogen, and environmental engineering.
- **Advanced Materials & Nanotechnology:** Graphene, smart polymers, and industrial materials.
- **Biotechnology & Healthcare Engineering:** Bioinformatics, biomedical devices, and pharmaceutical engineering.

## Campus Life & Student Services
- **Housing:** On-campus student dormitories for both male and female students with study rooms and dining facilities.
- **Transportation:** Shuttle buses connecting New Borg El Arab campus with Alexandria and nearby hubs.
- **Student Activities:** Robotics clubs, ACM/ICPC programming teams, entrepreneurship incubators, and cultural exchange programs with Japan.

title: Artificial Intelligence, RAG & CSIT Concepts
label: general
text:
## Core AI Disciplines
- **Machine Learning (ML):** Supervised learning (classification, regression), unsupervised learning (clustering, dimensionality reduction), and reinforcement learning.
- **Deep Learning:** Neural networks, Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) for vision, Transformers and attention mechanisms for language and multimodal tasks.
- **Natural Language Processing (NLP):** Tokenization, embeddings, Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and prompt engineering.

title: Artificial Intelligence, RAG & CSIT Concepts
label: general
text:
## How Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) Works
1. **Document Ingestion & Chunking:** Source documents are split into overlapping semantic chunks so each chunk fits cleanly in an embedding context window.
2. **Vector Embeddings:** An embedding model (such as `nvidia/nv-embedqa-e5-v5`) converts each chunk into a dense numerical vector capturing semantic meaning.
3. **Vector Indexing:** Vectors and metadata are stored in a vector database (such as Cloudflare Vectorize) for fast cosine-similarity search.
4. **Retrieval & Grounded Generation:** When a user asks a question, the query is embedded, the top-K most relevant chunks are retrieved, and an LLM (such as Llama 3.3 70B on NVIDIA NIM) generates an accurate, source-cited answer grounded in
